bible_verses.telugu: ఈయన తనద్వారా దేవునియొద్దకు వచ్చువారి పక్షమున, విజ్ఞాపనము చేయుటకు నిరంతరము జీవించుచున్నాడు గనుక వారిని సంపూర్ణముగా రక్షించుటకు శక్తిమంతుడై యున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

bible_verses.telugu: పితృపారంపర్యమైన మీ వ్యర్థప్రవర్తనను విడిచిపెట్టునట్లుగా వెండి బంగారములవంటి క్షయ వస్తువులచేత మీరు విమోచింపబడలేదుగాని అమూల్యమైన రక్తముచేత, అనగా నిర్దోషమును నిష్కళంకమునగు గొఱ్ఱపిల్లవంటి క్రీస్తు రక్తముచేత, విమోచింపబడితిరని మీరెరుగుదురు గదా
bible_verses.english: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors, but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for stepping down from heaven's glory to rescue a heart like mine. When I am overwhelmed by things I cannot understand, help me simply rest in the certainty of Your love. Thank You for Your precious sacrifice and for standing as my faithful Savior every single day. I place my trust in You alone, knowing my life is secure in Your hands. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for stepping down from heaven's glory to rescue a heart like mine. When I am overwhelmed by things I cannot understand, help me simply rest in the certainty of Your love. Thank You for Your precious sacrifice and for standing as my faithful Savior every single day. I place my trust in You alone, knowing my life is secure in Your hands. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: We don't need to comprehend every detail of God's vast design to rest in the beauty of His salvation. The quiet truth of the gospel remains simple and profound: Jesus left heaven's majesty to meet us in our deepest need. As you sing, let go of the pressure to have all the answers and anchor your heart in Christ's finished work. He stands before the Father interceding for you, offering a love that never lets go.
